title: Dune contours on paper
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: minimal personal website page-environment background, wide 16:9.
Primary request: an original computational illustration of huge rolling dune and ridge contours confined to the right side, with extensive empty near-white paper for actual website copy on the left.
Scene/backdrop: uniform nearly-white warm paper, approximately #F7F8F4, not green.
Subject: two or three enormous smoothly folded dune/ridge forms in sage, celadon, dusty teal and warm cream. The shapes are strong and immediately legible, preserving native muted color and crisp sculptural edges.
Composition/framing: LEFT 60 PERCENT of the entire canvas must remain completely flat blank nearly-white paper, without any image, texture, glyphs, gradients, shadows, or shapes. All illustrated forms confined to the RIGHTMOST 38 PERCENT, and extend beyond the RIGHT edge and TOP-RIGHT edge so this feels like a full-width page environment. The BOTTOM 12 PERCENT of the entire canvas is clean matching blank nearly-white paper. The forms must naturally resolve into the paper above that bottom band through sparse printed glyphs, without a hard rectangular boundary. Center-left fully empty. This is not a centered picture.
Style/medium: restrained computational print illustration, clearly visible micro-ASCII and terminal-glyph halftone marks model the dune contours and shading. Tiny precise character-like marks such as dots, colons, slashes and brackets, arranged as intentional tonal shading across the colored forms. Forms meet blank paper naturally through sparse printed glyphs at their inner and lower edges.
Lighting/mood: calm soft sculptural light, strong form and native color, no blur, no ghosted transparency.
Color palette: nearly-white #F7F8F4 paper ground; forms in sage, celadon, warm cream with dusty teal shading. No all-over green background.
Constraints: empty left 60 percent and bottom 12 percent are strict layout requirements. No readable words, letters arranged as text, logos, watermarks, UI, frame, card, enclosed oval, vignette, clouds, plants, people, or objects. No enclosing border. No full-scene landscape horizon across the empty left. No global grain overlay on the blank paper. Wide 16:9 landscape canvas.
